title: General Population and Housing Census 16-30 August 2022
description: The objective of the general population census is to have the full enumeration of all Rwandan residents as well as their key characteristics; for the planning of the well-being of Rwandan residents. The interview will last about 30 minutes. All provided answers will be kept confidential.

My names is ………………, I work for the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda as the enumerator of the General Population and housing census. The objective of the general population census is to have the full enumeration of all Rwandan residents as well as their key characteristics; for the planning of the well-being of Rwandan residents. I wish to talk with the head of the household. In general, the interview will last 30 min. All provided answers will be kept confidential. I hope that you accept the interview, as your responses are very important for the country.
questions.instructions: If interview accepted, proceed to PO1A (Start by making a list of HH members).

questions.text: Write the names of all resident household members who were present or absent in the reference census night (15-16/08/2022), and then all visitors who spent the census night within the household (if any).
questions.instructions: Enter names in the following order: 1. Household head, 2. Spouse, 3. Household head son or daughter, 4. Household adoptive child, 5. Father/Mother, 6.
